types.name: Square identities
types.description: Gives values like a + b, a − b or ab (or a sum of squares) and asks for a² + b², (a + b)², a − b, a⁴ + b⁴ or a product like (a + b)(a − b); no cubes and no 1/x terms.

types.name: Cube identities (two variables)
types.description: Gives a + b or a − b with ab (two variables, no 1/x) and asks for a³ + b³, a³ − b³ or (a ± b)³, or factorises a sum or difference of two cubes.

types.name: x + 1/x type
types.description: Involves x + 1/x, x − 1/x, x² + 1/x², x³ + 1/x³ and similar, including x given as a surd like 2 + √3 or an equation like x² − kx + 1 = 0.

types.name: a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc
types.description: Gives a + b + c with ab + bc + ca or a² + b² + c² and asks for a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc or a² + b² + c² for three variables.

types.name: Conditional identities
types.description: States a condition such as a + b + c = 0, a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc, a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ca, or a sum of squares equal to zero, and asks for a value that follows.

types.name: Simplify and evaluate
types.description: Asks to simplify or factorise an algebraic expression, or to find its value when the variables are given numbers (including surds).

types.name: Polynomials and remainders
types.description: Asks for a remainder, a factor, a quotient after dividing polynomials, the value of k that makes something a factor, or the sum or product of zeroes of a cubic.

types.name: Quadratic equations and roots
types.description: Mentions a quadratic equation or its roots α and β: solving it, the nature of roots, sum and product of roots, or forming a new equation from given roots.

types.name: Linear equations and word problems
types.description: Solves one or two linear equations, often from a story about costs, heads and legs, ages or numbers, and asks for a variable or a combination of them.

types.name: Unique, none or infinite solutions
types.description: Asks for the value of k or m that gives a pair of linear equations a unique solution, no solution or infinitely many solutions.

types.name: Maximum and minimum values
types.description: Asks for the least or greatest value of an algebraic expression, for example a quadratic, x + 1/x, or a sum under a fixed total.
